input:
learner text: 每天就是这样，这个坏人好像没有什么有希望的前途，就把希望寄托在梨子身上。
quote: 就把希望寄托在梨子身上
part p0: comment [ref p0/note] “寄托在偷梨子上” feels better, “寄托在……身上” usually for people, that is, a specific person carries the hope and can help the Subj. to realize the goal/objective.

edits.original: 把希望寄托在梨子身上
